findings.reason: I grepped the export and found no remaining reference to ranges/valid-range. index.js:60 and test/ranges/valid.js:2 both point at ./ranges/valid, so nothing in the repo breaks. package.json `files` publishes only bin, range.bnf and semver.js, so ranges/ never ships and outside code can't deep-import the old path. No story file says the old path had to stay.
findings.claim: Renaming ranges/valid-range.js to ranges/valid.js with no alias may break callers that deep-import the old path.
findings.evidence: diff.patch shows `rename from ranges/valid-range.js` / `rename to ranges/valid.js` (similarity 100%), and index.js:60 now reads `lazyExport('validRange', './ranges/valid')`. A grep of the export finds no remaining reference to `valid-range` and no re-export shim. The fix itself is consistent: test/ranges/valid.js:2 requires '../../ranges/valid', and map.js maps test/ranges/valid.js to ranges/valid.js. The packet has no story.md, so it can't confirm whether the old path was meant to stay supported. package.json `files` lists only bin, range.bnf and semver.js, which limits how much of this is published.
